entries.2720a2f4c693487a: This business manufactures and sells outboard motors, which are propulsion units for boats. Production is carried out by SUZUKI MOTOR CORPORATION in Japan and by its Thai subsidiary Thai Suzuki Motor Co.,Ltd. Sales are made through Suzuki Marine Co., Ltd. in Japan and through overseas sales companies such as Suzuki Marine USA, LLC.

entries.6740a20e6cd218ed: This business manufactures and sells motorcycles and buggies. Production is carried out by SUZUKI MOTOR CORPORATION in Japan and, overseas, by subsidiaries such as Suzuki Motorcycle India Private Ltd. entries.7b530af4532c49e1: This business manufactures and sells kei cars, small automobiles and standard automobiles.
